danas_saveti.razlog_sr: Intenzivan napor produbljuje udah — proceni simptome.
Vlaga je 91 % — veš se teško suši napolju.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Observer reads the moves of the maxima as news, but the PM10 top moved only from 20 to 23 [F5], NO2 from 68 to 71 [F7] and PM2.5 from 14 to 19 [F9], and the record holds 0 days to say what is usual [F47]. The small model itself rated these connections lowest in surprise [F51], and the maxima come from single stations, so the rank change to Leštane [F4] says nothing about the city. Note also that the source labels local time as Z, so the hour stamps are shaky [F3].
